IFI Techsolutions Renews Microsoft Azure Expert MSP Status

IFI Techsolutions Limited has successfully renewed its Microsoft Azure Expert MSP status for the fourth consecutive year. This renewal was granted following an independent third-party re-audit. The audit validated the company's delivery maturity, operational rigor, and customer outcomes.
